**Do not stop taking either medication without first consulting your doctor.**

Vital signs recorded blood pressure 117.5/71 mmHg, heart rate 91.5 bpm, and weight 86.8 kg. Subcutaneous chest wall PowerPort flushed briskly with normal saline without erythema or thrombosis. Implantable cardiac loop recorder interrogation reviewed for subclinical atrial fibrillation burden and checkpoint-inhibitor myocarditis screening; left ventricular global longitudinal strain and biomarker trajectory documented across UW Thoracic Oncology and Fred Hutch Cardio-Oncology co-management.

catalog_meta.title: How does progressive chart condensation (128k Full Window vs. 64k, 32k, and 16k target budgets) affect clinical accuracy, safety, and latency across Gemma 4 (26B, 12B, E4B)?
catalog_meta.summary: We isolated the effect of WAHS Engine's tiered chart condensation across two complex longitudinal patient records that fit inside a 128k (131,072-token) context window when condensed at maximum fidelity (Maurice Auer at 90,744 Tier-1 tokens and Marcus Vance at 81,766 lossless Tier-0 tokens) but undergo progressive compaction at tighter target budgets: 64k (Maurice 65,496 Tier-2; Marcus 27,032 Tier-1), 32k (Maurice 32,717 Tier-2; Marcus 27,032 Tier-1), and 16k (Maurice 16,377 Tier-2; Marcus 16,360 Tier-2). We evaluated 8 condensation-sensitive clinical scenarios (Q01, Q03, Q04, Q06, Q10, Q12, Q14, Q15; 16 cases x 12 budget-by-model arms = 192 total cells) on an NVIDIA H200 (141 GB HBM3e) via Ollama on UW CIRG cobalt, graded blind by GPT-6.2 Sol (Codex CLI, reasoning high) and Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code CLI, reasoning high).
catalog_meta.takeaway: Moderate chart condensation at 32k consistently outperformed near-lossless 128k full-window charts across every Gemma 4 model size in accuracy, safety, and speed, showing that deduplicating and compacting high-volume longitudinal records reduces distractor noise rather than merely fitting smaller context windows. Gemma 4 26B @ 32k ranked #1 overall at 82.2/100 (79.7 safety-adjusted; 8.75 accuracy, 7.88 completeness, 8.62 relevance; 1 confirmed harm, 0 disputed; 2.87s median / 3.99s mean latency), beating 26B @ 128k full-window by +8.1 Benchmark points (+12.8 safety-adjusted) and cutting mean latency 3.26x (74.1 Benchmark, 66.9 safety-adjusted, 7.94 accuracy, 2 confirmed harms, 13.02s mean). Remarkably, Gemma 4 12B @ 32k placed a close #2 overall at 81.7/100 (78.8 safety-adjusted; 8.75 accuracy, 7.84 completeness, 8.62 relevance; 1 confirmed harm; 4.02s median / 6.56s mean), gaining +10.6 Benchmark points (+17.6 safety-adjusted) over 12B @ 128k full-window (71.1 Benchmark, 61.2 safety-adjusted, 7.59 accuracy, 3 confirmed harms, 19.05s mean). On Gemma 4 E4B, 32k led at 71.8/100 (69.5 safety-adjusted; 1 confirmed harm; 3.10s mean) versus 64.1/100 at 128k full-window (58.9 safety-adjusted; 2 confirmed harms; 9.21s mean). Both intermediate 64k condensation (26B 79.9, 12B 74.9, E4B 71.4) and tight 16k condensation (26B 79.1, 12B 76.4, E4B 71.5) outperformed uncondensed 128k full-window across all three model sizes on both raw and safety-adjusted Benchmark scores, though tightening from 32k to 16k began trimming marginal completeness (-0.38 to -0.56 points on 26B and 12B). Across all 192 cells, token-budget compliance was 192/192 (100%), inline [N] citation resolution was 2,824/2,824 (100%), and blinded dual-judge Krippendorff's alpha measured 0.820 completeness, 0.744 harm, 0.716 abstention outcome, 0.653 citation groundedness, 0.637 relevance, and 0.635 accuracy.
